channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — SME
channel.description: Latest SME stories from BusinessHub.cy, Cyprus Edition.

item.title: Equipping Europeans for the age of AI: Council approves conclusions
item.description: The EU Council has approved a new framework to integrate AI literacy into education and professional training across all member states, including Cyprus.

item.title: EIB Group Climate Adaptation Plan Phase 2 – 2026-2030
item.description: The EIB Group doubles its climate adaptation funding to €30 billion for 2026-2030, specifically targeting SMEs and resilient infrastructure to mitigate growing climate risks.

item.title: Statement by the Minister of Finance on the affirmation of the credit rating of the Republic of Cyprus
item.description: Moody's has affirmed Cyprus's A3 investment-grade credit rating with a stable outlook, reflecting strong fiscal performance despite geopolitical instability and internal legislative risks.

item.title: Reminder for submission of applications for student benefits for the academic year 2025/2026 until 30 November for families of Greek students and for repatriated families of Cypriots
item.description: The Ministry of Finance reminds Greek and repatriated Cypriot families to apply for student benefits for the 2025/2026 academic year by November 30.

item.title: Extension of the Validity of Reduced Excise Duty Rates on Motor Fuels for the period from 1 December 2026 to 31 March 2027
item.description: The Cyprus government has extended reduced excise duty rates on motor fuels until March 31, 2027, to mitigate high energy costs for businesses and households.

item.title: Confirmation of the Republic of Cyprus's Credit Rating and Maintenance of Outlook by Moody’s Investors Service
item.description: Moody’s confirms Cyprus’s A3 rating with a stable outlook, citing fiscal resilience while warning of risks from labor reforms and infrastructure delays.

item.title: OECD Steel Committee: Joining forces to address accelerating global steel excess capacity
item.description: The OECD warns of a global steel excess capacity crisis reaching 700 million tonnes, threatening market stability through overproduction and market-distorting subsidies.

item.title: Stronger public finances and higher productivity are key to sustained growth in Colombia
item.description: The OECD's latest survey on Colombia highlights the need for fiscal consolidation and digital transformation to sustain growth amid rising debt and high inflation.

item.title: Jordan: EU and EIB back flagship water system providing water for 11 million people from one of the world’s largest desalination plants
item.description: The EU and EIB are providing over €1.1 billion in financing for Jordan's massive Aqaba-Amman water desalination project to secure water for 11 million people.

item.title: Temporary Suspension of DAC2/CRS File Submission Service
item.description: Cyprus Tax Department will suspend DAC2/CRS submissions from Dec 14, 2026, to Jan 17, 2027, to transition to the new XSD Schema v3.0 reporting standard.

item.title: IMF Executive Board Concludes Sixteenth Periodic Monitoring Report on the Status of Management Implementation Plans in Response to Board-Endorsed IEO Recommendations
item.description: The IMF has accelerated its internal reform implementation, closing 58% of open actions including social protection and capital flow advice, while introducing a new slippage risk framework.

item.title: Statement by IMF Deputy Managing Director Kenji Okamura at the Conclusion of His Visit to Malta
item.description: IMF Deputy Managing Director Kenji Okamura praised Malta's rapid economic growth while emphasizing the need for fiscal buffers and structural reforms to sustain long-term productivity.

item.title: IMF End-of-Mission Statement on Togo’s Fifth Review under the Extended Credit Facility Arrangement
item.description: An IMF mission visited Togo to review economic reforms under the ECF and discuss new climate-related funding, with a focus on fiscal sustainability and private-sector growth.

item.title: OECD to launch Africa's Development Dynamics 2026: Managing debt for transformation on 25 November
item.description: The OECD and African Union will launch a report on November 25th exploring how African nations can leverage sovereign debt to drive productivity and economic transformation.

item.title: OECD work and activities during COP31
item.description: The OECD is partnering with Türkiye for COP31 to provide technical analysis and tools, including the Climate Action Monitor, to accelerate global climate policy and emissions reductions.

item.title: Launch of the national digital financial literacy portal "moneypedia.cy"
item.description: Cyprus launches 'moneypedia.cy', a central digital portal dedicated to enhancing financial literacy and providing tools for informed economic decision-making.

item.title: Reaching Up for Faster Growth
item.description: Global growth is increasingly driven by AI and trade, but rising inflation and public debt necessitate cautious fiscal policies and urgent digital structural reforms for Cyprus businesses.

item.title: Price Index of Construction Materials - Annual Change +4,09% (Oct 2026)
item.description: The Price Index of Construction Materials in Cyprus rose by 4.09% year-on-year in October 2026, signaling continued upward pressure on building costs.

item.title: Production in construction up by 0.1% in the euro area
item.description: Euro area construction production edged up 0.1% in September 2026, though annual figures show a sustained decline, particularly in building construction.

item.title: Average gender employment gap in EU regions at 9.7 pp
item.description: Eurostat reports an average EU gender employment gap of 9.7 percentage points, highlighting persistent labor market disparities across member states.

item.title: OECD GDP growth slows slightly to 0.6% in the third quarter of 2026
item.description: OECD GDP growth slowed slightly to 0.6% in Q3 2026, driven by weak net trade in G7 nations despite strong domestic demand in the US and UK.

item.title: As AI transforms the data landscape, OECD strengthens safeguards for trustworthy statistics
item.description: The OECD updated its statistical quality framework to include AI safeguards, ensuring data credibility and 'AI-readiness' amid shifting data sources and processing methods.

item.title: Price Index οf Construction Materials: October 2026
item.description: The Cyprus Construction Materials Price Index rose 4.09% year-on-year in October 2026, driven by sharp increases in metallic and electrical products.

item.title: Colombia: End-of-Mission Press Release
item.description: IMF mission to Colombia highlights urgent fiscal consolidation needs and the proposed Economic Rescue Law to stabilize debt and rebuild investor confidence following recent economic shocks.

item.title: IMF Staff Concludes Staff Visit to Qatar
item.description: The IMF reports that Qatar's economy will contract 14.5% in 2026 due to regional conflict, but strong non-hydrocarbon resilience and LNG expansion point to a 2027 recovery.

item.title: IMF Staff Completes 2026 Article IV Mission to United Arab Emirates
item.description: IMF reports UAE economic resilience amid regional conflict, projecting a growth surge to 7.3% in 2027 as disruptions ease and non-hydrocarbon sectors recover.

item.title: Kazakhstan: Staff Concluding Statement for the 2026 Article IV Mission
item.description: IMF's 2026 Article IV mission reports moderated 4.6% growth in Kazakhstan with persistent inflation, advising tighter fiscal policy and structural reforms amid downside risks.

item.title: IMF Staff Concludes Visit to Lithuania
item.description: The IMF warns that Lithuania's growth will moderate as inflation stays high, fueled by expansionary fiscal policies and strong wage growth, risking long-term competitiveness.

item.title: A Quarter Century of Inflation Targeting in Latin America: Progress, Challenges, and the Road Ahead
item.description: IMF discusses Latin America's inflation targeting success and future risks, highlighting the importance of early policy action and central bank credibility in volatile global markets.

item.title: IMF Staff Reaches Staff Level Agreement on Egypt’s Eighth Review Under the Extended Arrangement under the Extended Fund Facility and Third Review Under the Resilience and Sustainability Facility
item.description: The IMF has reached a staff-level agreement with Egypt for a $2.3 billion disbursement, signaling continued economic stabilization and reform in a key regional market for Cyprus.

item.title: IMF Staff Completes 2026 Article IV Mission to the Republic of Korea
item.description: The IMF projects strong growth for South Korea driven by a global AI and semiconductor boom, though inflation risks and tech-sector concentration remain key concerns.

item.title: Sierra Leone: IMF Staff Reaches Staff-Level Agreement on the Fourth Review Under the Extended Credit Facility Arrangement and the First Review Under the Resilience and Sustainability Facility
item.description: IMF staff reached an agreement to unlock $78.2 million for Sierra Leone, pending board approval, amid efforts to stabilize inflation and address fiscal pressures.

item.title: IMF Press Briefing | November 12, 2026
item.description: The IMF's November 2026 briefings focused on global economic shifts, the future of the U.S. dollar, and transition risks in a multipolar world.

item.title: Industrial production up by 0.2% in the euro area
item.description: Euro area industrial production saw a marginal 0.2% monthly increase in September 2026, though annual output remains down by 1.5% amid a sharp decline in non-durable consumer goods.

item.title: EU severe material and social deprivation rate: 6.3%
item.description: Cyprus reports a 6.7% severe material and social deprivation rate, slightly exceeding the EU average of 6.3%, signaling underlying challenges in consumer purchasing power.

item.title: Vulnerability profiles of least developed countries
item.description: UNCTAD has released updated vulnerability profiles for Least Developed Countries (LDCs) to assess their readiness for graduation from the LDC category.

item.title: Opening Keynote Address of the Chief Scientist for Research, Innovation and Technology of the Republic of Cyprus, Dr Demetris Skourides, at the 10th PMI Cyprus Chapter Project Management Conference
item.description: Chief Scientist Demetris Skourides calls for a paradigm shift in Cyprus's project management, emphasizing the integration of AI to move from execution to 'intelligent execution.'

item.title: Real household income in the OECD contracts slightly in Q2 2026
item.description: OECD real household income per capita edged down 0.1% in Q2 2026, as persistent inflation began outpacing nominal wage gains despite continued GDP growth.

item.title: OEB: Award Ceremony of the Cyprus Innovation Awards of the OEB and the Cyprus Research Awards of the RIF
item.description: OEB and RIF will host the joint 19th Cyprus Innovation and Research Awards on October 26, 2026, to honor excellence in business innovation and scientific research.

item.title: Choosing Growth: Reforms for Innovation, Scale, and Resilience
item.description: The IMF warns Europe to prioritize fiscal consolidation and structural reforms to counter rising sovereign yields, energy shocks, and stagnant growth.

item.title: IMF Executive Board Concludes 2026 Article IV Consultation and Mid-Term Review and Request for Reduction of Access under Flexible Credit Line Arrangement with Mexico
item.description: The IMF approved Mexico's credit line reduction following improved economic stability, while advising tighter fiscal policies to manage debt and inflation despite a projected growth recovery through 2027.

item.title: Finland: Staff Concluding Statement of the 2027 Article IV Mission
item.description: Finland's economy enters a recovery phase driven by exports and investment, though high unemployment and fiscal deficits necessitate structural reforms and consolidation.

item.title: IMF Staff Concludes Visit to Georgia
item.description: The IMF reports robust 7.2% growth for Georgia in 2026 driven by ICT and trade, while warning that persistent inflation may necessitate tighter monetary policy.

item.title: IMF Staff Completes 2026 Article IV Mission to Vietnam
item.description: Vietnam's economy is projected to grow by 9.2% in 2026, driven by AI and tech, though inflation risks and trade uncertainties remain for international partners.

item.title: Creating the Conditions for Lasting Diversification in Algeria
item.description: Algeria is intensifying efforts to diversify its economy away from hydrocarbons through large-scale infrastructure projects and regulatory reforms to stimulate private sector growth.

item.title: Inclusive Framework on Base Erosion and Profit Shifting Plenary Meeting Opening, remarks by OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann
item.description: OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann highlights the global implementation of the 15% minimum tax and outlines future priorities for international tax cooperation and profit-shifting prevention.

item.title: OECD unemployment rate stable at 5.0% in September 2026, while youth unemployment rate reaches 11.5%
item.description: The OECD unemployment rate held steady at 5.0% in September 2026, though youth unemployment rose to 11.5% and gender gaps persisted in Greece and the Eurozone.

item.title: Government support to agriculture grew by 15% in the last two years and much of it is distortive, says OECD
item.description: Global agricultural support rose 15% to $885 billion, largely through distortive subsidies that risk long-term productivity and increase consumer costs, according to the OECD.

item.title: Reforms can strengthen Belgium’s competitiveness, unlock its growth potential and support sustainable public finances
item.description: The OECD urges Belgium to implement structural reforms in wage-setting, public spending, and green energy to address rising debt and slowing GDP growth.

item.title: Rising exposure to extreme heat and droughts poses growing risks to economies, OECD finds
item.description: The OECD reports a massive global increase in extreme heat and a decline in soil moisture, threatening agricultural stability, energy production, and international supply chains.
